test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-II Official Paper (Held On: 20 Dec, 2025)
subject: general
question:
I, J, K, L, R, S and T are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

Only two people sit between K and T when counted from the right of K. Only three people sit between S and L when counted from the right of L. T sits to the immediate right of L. J sits to the immediate right of R.

Who sits fourth to the right of I?
solution:
Given:

 

1. Only two people sit between K and T when counted from the right of K.

 

2. T sits to the immediate right of L.

 

3. Only three people sit between S and L when counted from the right of L.

 

4. J sits to the immediate right of R. 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f490dec0c7718c623e4b12f16ca82bf447dfb0f2a8e79762116ed9a123053eab.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a6022dd1ac70a44c64f535bf1fccf06c7b917f69fa4d1b5c05b1d7506b1a5a7.png] 

Thus, J sits to the 4th to the right of I.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
